name: Repair a straight route that crosses equipment
assumptions: This room and pipe are invented for testing. They are not extracted from the supplied ship drawings.
Millimeters are chosen for this example. The supplied drawings still have unconfirmed units.
The 150 mm clearance is a test value. It is not an organizer requirement.
The 100 mm diameter represents the pipe's outer diameter. Insulation is not included.
The box is a permitted routing space. The equipment bank is the only modeled obstacle.
Each direction change adds 300 mm to the search score. This is a tunable preference rather than a physical length.
The example represents one pressurized pipe. It has no drain slope requirement.
